title: Contents
slide_intent: Help readers find the decision they need by separating topics and giving each a numbered place in the book.
strategic_value: A designer working for one venue can locate both its specific rules and the institution-wide foundations using the same index.
demonstration: Three text columns group nine numbered sections, from introduction and trust identity to venue marks, design foundations, applications and contact.
practical_value: Find the section number for a particular task, such as a venue icon or an exhibition type treatment, before opening its examples.
